text:
kari: Hey team, quick Ruby/ASDF question. Trying to install Ruby 3.1.2 with asdf on my M2 Mac and gem native extensions (nokogiri, pg) fail during build with missing openssl/libxml/readline headers. I have Homebrew at /opt/homebrew and installed openssl@3 libxml2 readline but the ruby build still errors. Any compact checklist?

miguel: welcome! Common pattern for mac arm: install the brew deps then point the ruby build at them. Example steps I use:

brew install openssl@3 libxml2 readline gdbm pkg-config
export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"
export LDFLAGS="-L/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/libxml2/lib -L/opt/homebrew/opt/readline/lib"
export CPPFLAGS="-I/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/include -I/opt/homebrew/opt/libxml2/include -I/opt/homebrew/opt/readline/include"
export PKG_CONFIG_PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib/pkgconfig:/opt/homebrew/opt/libxml2/lib/pkgconfig"
export RUBY_CONFIGURE_OPTS="--with-openssl-dir=/opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3 --with-readline-dir=/opt/homebrew/opt/readline --with-libxml-dir=/opt/homebrew/opt/libxml2"
asdf install ruby 3.1.2
If installing gems like nokogiri separately, use: `gem install nokogiri -- --use-system-libraries --with-xml2-dir=/opt/homebrew/opt/libxml2`

zoe: Also check for rbenv/ruby-install leftovers. `which ruby` should point to `~/.asdf/shims/ruby`. If you used system Ruby earlier, bundler might have created gems under /usr/local. Run `asdf reshim ruby` and `gem env` to inspect paths.

kari: I had an old /usr/local/Cellar/openssl from an Intel brew. Removed it and re-pointed PKG_CONFIG_PATH to /opt/homebrew. Re-ran asdf install and ruby compile succeeded. However `bundle install` still fails for nokogiri inside the app.

miguel: inside the app, try `bundle config build.nokogiri --use-system-libraries --with-xml2-dir=/opt/homebrew/opt/libxml2` then `bundle install`. That makes bundler pass the flags to gem install. Also ensure `pkg-config --modversion libxml-2.0` prints a version. If not, PKG_CONFIG_PATH is wrong.

zoe: FYI we keep a tiny helper in the dotfiles: `macos/ruby/README.md` with the env block and a `scripts/fix-ruby-build.sh` that sets envs and runs asdf install. If you update anything please add a short note in the repo.

dotfiles-bot: When you open a PR to dotfiles include the snippet template and a changelog entry.

kari: Thanks folks 60a Rebuilt with the PKG_CONFIG_PATH fix and bundle config, everything installed. I'll open a 2-line PR to macos/ruby/README.md with the exact exports and the bundle config example. Appreciate the quick help!
